wrap.new_row_condition: each 8px step (subrow_accumulator bit3) streams a row via 0x406A4

scroll_decision_order: player movement queues motion into pending_up/pending_down
step dispenser caps at 4 px/frame -> scroll_delta (0x51880)
clamp controller keeps player_screen_y in [32,304] band center 80, arms scroll_step+flags (0x539C2)
dispatch: if dir_accumulator>=160 and section-kind gate set -> stop (flag bit6); else accumulate subrow, stream row per 8px, fg_y_scroll +=/-= step mod 512 (0x557BA/0x55854)
wrap_rules: both axes wrap pixel scroll value mod 512; vertical is a 64-tile ring
vertical_climb_state4: while climbing, movement feeds pending_up; step dispenser emits up to 4px/frame; fg_y_scroll advances upward mod 512 and streams rows until dir_accumulator limit (160, gated by A5+0x10A8) or screen-Y band clamp stops it
third_chain_contract: from scene-init fg_y_scroll 0x160, an upward climb moves the committed Y toward ~0x010D and keeps moving; a value stuck at ~0x0026 means the up path (pending_up->scroll_delta->fg_y_scroll+=step) is not driven
pc080sn_cut: preserve everything up to fg_y_scroll (mod 512) + logical map row; hardware side = write fg_y_scroll to 0xC40002 + name-table ring row walk (+0xFE stride)
